items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Bill Kenney, Cootie Williams (the bandleader) and Deak Watson (one of the Ink Spots) they controlled the money.

ctx.x: about off-stage. And they had to handle an awful lot of money, a terrific amount of money. They liked to gamble, they liked to pass the money around. And the boys in the band, they accommodated them. They would see that the money was passed around, split up and this-that-and-the-other.

Bill Kenney, Cootie Williams (the bandleader) and Deak Watson (one of the Ink Spots) they controlled the money. And Bill Kenney and Deak Watson were partners in their act, but Deak Watson did not like Bill Kenney and Bill Kenney did not like Deak Watson in the gambling part. And each one was trying to break the other. And Cootie was in on that, too. The three of them were trying to break one another. And while they were trying to break one another, the other part of the band was just nippin' away at all three of…
Well, I mean, it gave you something to do and it kept you on your toes, too. And it was very interesting to see how greedy some people can be after money.
